'''Maredo''' was a nation that came into existence after the [[Hundred Years War]]. It was located in the present day [[Plains of Maredo]] between [[Illian]] and [[Tear]]. 

In {{fy|999}}, the nation of Maredo was founded by Lady [[Danella Mathendrin]] and other nobles from the city of Far Madding, laying claim to all of the Plains of Maredo and a part of Murandy, but by {{ne|500}}, the nation had vanished, leaving only Far Madding as a city-state.

Maredo was ruled by queens, and was thus a matriarchal nation.{{ref/book|9|24}} Its capital was [[Far Madding]],{{ref/book|9|22}} and the city's female [[Counsel]] served as an advisor to the queen. After the nation's collapse, Far Madding remained as a city-state, and the First Counsel began to view herself as the political successor of the queens of Maredo.{{ref/book|9|24}}
